sentences.span: Demand can be infinite and the stocks can still go down if the infinite demand arrives at a price that does not service the debt issued to build the plants.
sentences.why: Direct paraphrase: 'infinite'→'enormous', 'go down'→'fall', 'debt issued to build the plants'→'debt raised to build the capacity'. Meaning preserved.

sentences.span: ahead of NFP given GS is below street consensus (+40k) with street whispers for an even lower number
sentences.why: JPM Feroli=50k, street=55k, prior=-23k (15226/15227) and DB Reid=+65k/-23k/55k (15294) are correctly sourced. But 40k is the source's label for 'street consensus', with GS's own forecast stated to be BELOW 40k (unspecified) — the sentence wrongly attributes 40k as Goldman's own house call.

sentences.span: we view CPI as more impactful and that NFP is operating in a 'Good News is ...' ... CPI on Sep 11 the more important of the two prints

No source document in the corpus states that a specific factor 'carried the first half' and is now gone. Nearest candidates (momentum unwind in 15317, AI trade discussion in 15313) describe August/summer dynamics, not an H1-specific claim; none use this framing.

sentences.span: The selloff in momentum (GSPRHIMO) has now surpassed 20pp in the last week, exceeding our short term expectations for a summer slump in the factor.
sentences.why: JPM half (21%/34% from June ATH) is faithfully sourced to 15317 (dated Sept 4). But the Goldman 'shed 20pp in a single week... summer slump' clause is lifted from a document timestamped Wed 8 Jul 2026 — nearly two months stale — and is presented as concurrent current-week action alongside the September JPM data, misrepresenting when it happened.

sentences.span: Because they are staying put... renovations now account for 25 percent of private construction.
sentences.why: 25% figure matches exactly; 'spending that used to go into moving now goes into staying' is a faithful paraphrase of the source's lock-in/renovation-boom narrative and its explicit 'long the repair and remodel complex... Americans fix what they have' trade call.

sentences.span: If turnover stays frozen while remodeling spending holds up, the widening gap between homebuilders and renovation becomes the relative-value opportunity.
sentences.why: The source's own taxonomy treats 'Homebuilders' (Blue) and 'Transactions' — brokerages/lenders/title companies (Red) — as distinct categories; the actual widening gap it calls out is between homebuilders and renovation, not between 'transaction-linked' names and renovation. The sentence substitutes the wrong counterparty.
